t:
It's nice to get some fresh air. Shh, I'm incognito here.

So many important people. I'm surprised they didn't invite the whole Conclave. But you know, people would rather go to a party than a war. How many of them will join our ranks when the time comes? Exactly.

Daddy will make his move soon. He enjoys toying with us for now, but when push comes to shove, he is ruthless.

But alright, I won't spoil your fun. Enjoy yourself! Set off fireworks, set fire to Catherina's skirt, drink with the crocodile! Have fun.

t:
Oh, we can't do it without you, ! We've been waiting for you!

Alright, enough joking. You see, not everyone danced at the Balls and drank Irene wine this year. Some of us were actually busy!

It worked well with the army of dead. They did your job for you. Your assault on the Citadel could have gone a little better. Rewards are all you care about!

You didn't make it to the last level? I bet "Father" would be so pleased!

But this is not about him. Destroying another avatar? It's about time, but it won't solve all our problems. I have a solution. What kind? Ah, you're so quick with words. I wish you were as efficient with your actions. I'll tell you everything later... When the time comes.

For now, have fun - go fly a glider and win that lion if you haven't already.
r495911.n: Oh, we can't do it without you, ! We've been waiting for you! Alright,…

t:
So not a single event happens without you, ? Perhaps it's true.

Look at them. They will drown you in words, predictions, promises, maybe even veiled threats...

Do not trust anyone. Now is the moment you can determine your own future.

You need to understand that the choice is yours. And you will have to make it no matter what.

Very interesting...

Children of Chaos attach a lot of importance to certain dates of the cycle. I noticed you need special rituals to remember your past.

Even now, when your sun is hidden from you, so you cannot measure time the way you could before.

What drives you? It's unclear.

Child of Chaos...

The time when you will have to make a choice is near.

I detect a temporal effect spreading throughout the world. Someone is trying to change the course of events. To warp the river of time into meanders. No, Cosmos has no part in it.

Soon you will understand everything. For now, celebrate.

t:
Hello, hello!

The Threads of Fate have led you to me again.

I guess you would like to learn about your future. About Horizon and everything else I showed you.

Know that the future can be changed. It is like roads –– they fork and merge. Have you seen the Frozen Frontier? The way it looked before the end? Then, perhaps, you've seen Horizon as well. These are all versions of the future. If I make a step to the side, the road will change.

But is there a path where Sarnaut is saved? I touched all the Threads one by one, but alas, the path I showed you is the most likely one. And yet there's still hope. I believe everything is in your hands.

t:
Greetings, !

I wonder what the Threads are saying? It's an interesting matter, because the predictions are starting to get confusing...

I thought our future was set in stone, and the Darkness would swallow Sarnaut, but since then, the visions have been showing me something different. And it looks like someone is trying to change the pattern, tangling the Threads. It's unprecedented, but I can't say it's completely unbelievable.

In our family, only some of the legends about the past are preserved, because we only had a few weaver's looms on our island. The True Holders of the Thread could read the Fabric of the World more accurately, but they all remained on Isa, our ancestral home, and it no longer exists.

t:
Oh child, who knew it would turn out like this! The Darkness outwitted everyone, and we... couldn't do anything! They say Nihaz created a false future in order to deceive us all... It was very, very cunning, but no one has been able to escape fate yet. When he diverted the course of the river of time, the god of darkness might have sealed his fate.

The future will show us the truth. Right now I'm here to tell you that I'm going to New Isa, to the Great Tree. Disturbing news came from Froddy. Something troubling is going on. I need to see everything myself, and then I will tell you what it is.

But... do you happen to know why that ghostly wretch from Gipat is staring at me?

We’ll see what happens!

Let’s start already. My men are hungry for battle! We will take revenge on this bastard for manipulating us like puppets. Oh, I’m going to smash Gorislav’s face if I see him! And he called himself Gipitsky to be like us, the bastard!

Oh, great. You're here, too.

Having fun? Seems that way. And can you believe that? No one is holding anyone by the throat or kicking their skulls in. If they all met ten years ago - you can imagine the scuffle, I'm sure.

What I mean is, the world has changed. And it happened thanks to you. Yes, yes, no need for modesty.

Rysina and Yasker are side-eyeing me, but I'm sure they've come to accept the fact that Orc Psionicists exist. My school is flourishing. We are gathering talents from all over Sarnaut. We even visit savages that probably skewered some unlucky travelers just yesterday - and we find gems there. And that is thanks to you, too.

t:
! You're here, too!

We came here right after Irene. There's something we need to discuss...

With the Empire, too! No, I had nothing to do with any rebellions. That's Shamans' doing, I had no idea what they were planning...

Ugh, soon I'll have to start training... on Nea. It's too bad I'll have to leave my school... Though they promised to keep an eye on it. Who? Unn, that furball. She has some kind of authority with the Gibberlings, so everything should be all right on Coldberg.

I hope I'm not in trouble... Because Rysina and Yasker have been giving me dirty looks. Anyway, congratulations on your Anniversary!
r496205.n: ! You're here, too! We came here right after Irene. There's something…

t:
Ha ha, ! The old friends are together once again.

I was miraculously released from this Suslanger! It was nothing but trouble. I was starting to forget my titles and regalia... Who am I? A trainer of Orc Psionicists? Zayan’s apprentice? The chief of the Horde? A navigator of other worlds?

Ugh, the thought makes me shudder. There's one good thing about it - Fury is helping me. She is a sensible one, even if hot tempered. If she sees a problem, she goes at it with an axe! Heh.

Anyway, we decided to take a break from all that... Let Kurgan lead them for now. We're going to travel around the world for a month or so, while there's still time...

Time until what? Didn't Eladia tell you? Hmm, maybe I shouldn't say anything, but they are mounting an Expedition. And they can't do it without me, since I'm... the navigator. But it takes time to prepare everything... And they still can't find that damn Chronophone. It would take even longer to build another one. So we still have time to kill.

Well, if they haven't called you yet, they will soon. Rest for now! Well, see you around.

Yes, I knew you would do the same! But of course you would. Klavdia and I agreed to inform her mother - it had to be done.

And as for Felix and his iron blockheads - as defenders of Sarnaut they are worthless. Just fools who messed up when they put us at war with the Children.
r496207.n: It was nice to fight side by side with you.

Yes, it was unpleasant. But I couldn't do otherwise, and neither could Eurial. Klavdia and I agreed to inform her mother - it had to be done.

But I don't hold grudges, so if you're ready to forget about the past, then I'll forget it, too.

I'll be going to Suslanger with Fury: I need to see what the Landfill Warriors are up to, hehe... And then, perhaps, I'll return to Zayan - I still need to complete this training.

Are you interested in our ghouls? The ghouls are all ready.

This type of undead are natural necrophages, that is – corpse eaters. We use them, among other things, to clean up unfortunate zombies. Of course, they need to be kept separate from the rest. Without supervision they will seriously shrink our army.

As for the pirate – my conversation with him was very interesting. Ah, the pirate’s life – lost islands full of treasure. Our friend sent me approximate coordinates. Maybe when this is all over, I’ll organize an expedition.

Stormbringer!

How interesting it is to see other allods that are so different from Ammer! We came when Zayan called on us to be present for an unprecedented act. Until now, our people were born from the pure energy of the Well of Souls, but what if it runs out one day? Will we be doomed with irrevocable losses like the Arisen?

If everything works out for you, this will be the dawn of a new era for the Aoidoi!

t: The Snow Lizard is really fast. Too fast to freeze!
Amarantha's Clerk. I hold its history, properties and affairs in my hands. I have nothing for you, but I'll make sure to record your contribution to our history.
! Everything is fine, thank you. There's peace and stability in Amarantha for a change. And you're still trying to help out, I see? That's admirable.

Well, after Gorluxor’s defeat and the second death of Armando, we all ran for the hills. Carmilla, Armando’s wife, brought us to Amaranth. For some time we lived in the Patriarch's Residence, but when a bunch of heroes like you showed up, I had to flee to the depths of the allod. Carmilla disappeared, and then Wigo, one of Armando’s nephews, began to lead us. Of course, not everyone agreed when we created Amaranth and decided not to drink the blood of intelligent creatures. Many left. But my beloved Abelard and I decided to stay.
r499178.n: How did you end up in Amaranth anyway?

t: You know, fine. Demons are demons. I saw enough of them when we lived in Gorluxor's Tower on Yazes. But, of course, they were unusually black. I honestly don’t know why you're all so afraid of them.
r499184.n: How do you feel after that experiment with the demon?

t: Really? It won't work! They'll never forgive us for what we've done, switching sides from Tep to Sarn. Politics is too messy, anyway. The House de Doucer used to be the strongest of the eight. When we made a mistake, they didn't want to listen. They just expelled us. We also suffered, but no one cared.
r499185.n: What do you think of Gala’s plan?

t:
They... swore allegiance to the Dark One...  that’s how they want evade death... in a doomed world... that will soon be swallowed in darkness!

Many were against it... but now power is held by those... who forgot... Nihaz’s betrayal...

Now they have accepted the darkness... and they serve it...

Now... let me peacefully... die...

Ready... to strike! Wipe away everything! Everything!

Agrus is possessed by hatred... He wants to erase the doomed world... And us with it...

They have been secretly gathering strength for several years now... This isn’t the only island... There are thousands... thousands!

Draconids breed at a terrifying rate... The world knew nothing of them until very recently. And in just a few years they have multiplied so intensely they threaten to overwhelm the whole world and wipe away everything in an avalanche of scaly flesh...

And now there is no one to stop them... The Destroyer Temple is ruined... They are dead... by your hand!

And my people... have committed a grave crime...

I was sent to investigate... We had to be sure...

There... so many now... so many... they are ready... ready...
Idiots... why did you come here?

t:
The Free Traders can't sit idly when troubles plague the world!

Nihaz's spies are everywhere – how does one decide who can be trusted and who should be feared?

So we came up with this idea: 30 days and 30 tasks for each day – no spy can handle that! The deeds are useful, and rewards are valuable. Everyone is happy!

But we know heroes can have one of those days, so don't worry: you can skip a few quests that turn out to be too difficult. You can still earn the best reward.

It's easy: I'll be here every day, and each day you can get a special task for me. If you complete it on the same day, you'll get a reward that you can exchange later. And if you don't, you get nothing.

And you do that 30 days in a row, each day with it own task!
You can see the prizes right here – just trade with me! But the best prizes are reserved for the most persistent ones!

t:
What's there to explain?

 There's war on our doorstep. Demons, League, some other arch... ah, Tep take it!

 Anyway, war makes some people rich.

 The Free Traders supply the best weapons. We sell them. But if you give some dolt an astral cannon, they can only hammer nails with it.

 So you need to find someone skilled to make us some profit and do good for the world.

 So we arranged a Marathon – 30 days and 30 quests, and those can do it will receive a reward!

And don't be afraid - we're not so cruel as to make you do everything! You can skip a couple of difficult quests - you will still receive the best reward as long as you have enough coins!

It's easy – just come to me every day and pick up a task, and I'll give you a coin! In the end, you will buy prizes and be happy. Just keep in mind that the task can be completed only on the same day – we do not tolerate delays!

We prepared a special task for each day, so don't skip them!

Buy your prizes, and if you couldn't participate – don't despair and wait for the next race!
The old district is not ready to receive guests. Come back later! I'll take you there.
The southern districts are not ready to receive guests. Come back later! I'll take you there.
Here we are holding a rather unusual event: under the guise of decorum, we learn to be ourselves and have fun! Speak with Solemna de Ardeur – she should be somewhere on the podium.
Fun under the guise of decorum! Come in and speak with Solemna de Ardeur, or jump in and enjoy yourself! Don't let snobbish comments discourage you!
A true social event! Don't waste your time – enter and prove yourself, and if you need something, speak with Cecilia de Grandeur, she's in charge of this event.
Soon a social event will take place here! I suggest you speak with Cecilia de Grandeur - she is in charge of this event.
What are you waiting for?! Come in before you miss it!
r502312.n: What are you waiting for?! Come in before you miss it!

t: Next lesson will begin soon! Don't miss it!
r502313.n: Next lesson will begin soon! Don't miss it!

t: We ask you to take part in this noble endeavor – it's in full swing!
r502316.n: We ask you to take part in this noble endeavor – it's in full swing!

t: Oh, ! Don't stray too far, our lesson is starting soon!
r502320.n: Oh, ! Don't stray too far, our lesson is starting soon!

t: So many new faces! Many of them look unfamiliar, but who knows, whose soul is hiding behind the mask?
r502691.n: So many new faces! Many of them look unfamiliar, but who knows, whose…

t:
Oh Great Ball, the kingdom of beauty and luxury. For me and you, a lot of work, too. Just look around! All of them wish to change their appearance before the Ball.

I am the Master of Changes. I can make you look completely different. I bring changes into your life, whether it's just hairstyle, hair color, physique, or gender. I can go even further! My thorough knowledge of magic and physiology will allow me to change your race!

It will cost you a few more Carnival Masks. The number depends on how profound the changes will be.

So, have you made up your mind?
I have nothing to tell you.
It would be great if you could find me a bottle of Irene semi-sweet wine. My throat is dry, and I'm bored as hell.
I have no time! No time at all! Can you get me some frog leg soup?
Of course! I need something light and merry to drink. With bubbles, you know? Light and bubbly, yes.
Right on time. We were going to have some wine. Can you bring us something... you know, something that goes best with wine?
Hello! Oh, why am I so bored in a place like this?
r502891.n: Hello! Oh, why am I so bored in a place like this?

t: I'm Linda de Avale. Haven't you heard the legend? These creatures were made by the most powerful Mages of the first Conclave. They needed someone to test their elf-transforming spells on. Over time, fairies spread all over the world, but only here, on Irene, you can find the primal fairies that remember the names of their creators. I want to have them as servants in my House.
r503002.n: Fairies? Who are you? Why do you need them?

t: Unforgivable ignorance. House de Avale is a glorious house, although it's not one of the Great Houses. Our abode is the Florenta allod. One of the Great Houses gave us shelter. We're few, but we're united. Our profession is pet training. You know, cats, dogs, and the like. Everyone's crazy about them. I think that taming a real Irene fairy would be a real challenge. Not just anyone with a basket of berries, but a truly beautiful fairy. The one that can be found only on Irene.
r503004.n: House de Avale? Never heard of it.

t: Oh, Irene! The motherland of magic fairies! I'm dreaming to find them!
r503006.n: Oh, Irene! The motherland of magic fairies! I'm dreaming to find them!

t: The glory of our House has long gone. Our House used to be rich, prosperous, and famous. Alas, time takes its toll. We lost too much during the Night of Astral Portals, when the Ark allod was destroyed and the Great Mage Erast died. But we remain optimistic. We grant shelter to Sarnaut travelers. You can see our residences in all corners of the world.
r503009.n: House de Ark? What House is that?

t: Bruno de Amfas, at your service. I represent House de Amfas at the Great Ball. Royal etiquette and traditions are my specialty. I've always dreamed of coming here, and now I have this opportunity! Who could have thought that Irene would be found and chosen as the Great Ball site! Look how well this place has been restored! As if it hadn't been ten centuries!

Really? Weird. This is a minor House. However, we're pretty famous. We served the Great Mage Pascal in the dukedom of Mebir! My noble ancestor was the butler in Mebir tower! Alas, we had to run away after the Cataclysm. We found shelter at the allod Malar. We have to preserve our etiquette skills in the society of savage Kanians... it isn't easy, but somebody's got to do it. I've been told that the guests undergo etiquette training here. Let's see if the training complies with the ancient elven traditions! We can't allow to distort our traditions!
r503012.n: I've never heard about House de Amfas. Tell me about it.

t: Gunter de Venar, at your service, my friend. I'm a famous racer. I raced on Kirah, on Ammer, but... I heard rumors that races might be organized here, on Irene. You understand, I couldn't miss the opportunity! What can be better than speed? Fresh wind in my face! Nothing. Tell me if you hear about the race, alright?

I'm Colette de Ark, a herbalist. You might think, what a weird profession for an elven lady. Sometimes life leaves you no choice. I'm staying in a stronghold of one of the guilds, helping them cure local peasants.

Hmm. I admit, our name isn't habitual in Sarnaut... Alright, I'll tell you: our House lives on Ignis, Antoinette de Delice is our Great Mage. She gives us shelter and protection. Ignis is a curious allod: a country of eternal summer, with sandy beaches free from crowds of tourists, unlike the Summer Atoll. I remember, fifty years ago when Yasker and his soldier occupied Ignis, the Xadaganians only hanged out with the girls instead of fighting. Anyway, it's a bit on the tight and boring side. I'm trying to persuade Antoinette to open at least casinos, but she won't allow that. So I have to seek fun elsewhere.
r503015.n: I've never heard about House de Venar.

t: My name is Jennifer de Gloire. I represent the minor House, but my true goal is to dance at the Great Ball. I know that preparations take time, but I just can't wait for it to start. Oh, the dance! The pinnacle of elven grace! What can be more beautiful than unite in harmony with other elves?
r503016.n: Good afternoon! Tell me about yourself.

t: Yes, we have! In Cosmos Observatory, in the lair of the blind demon Cairage... But I can't tell for sure if I saw you or some other hero. The Observatory is a weird place. It's like a room full of mirrors, with unique reflections in each of them. As far as I know, Cairage was dealt with in our world.
Greetings! Oh, the charming antiquity! Irene is amazing, isn't it?
r503018.n: Greetings! Oh, the charming antiquity! Irene is amazing, isn't it?

t: Oh! Haven't you heard about our House? It is no equal to the Great Houses, of course, but it used to shine back in the day. Members of my House were permanent members of the Dernier royal dynasty entourage back in the day when Irene was a kingdom. We lived a carefree life, without worries, without thinking of the future... and then the Cataclysm struck. Not many were saved. We were scattered on different allods. We reunited just recently under the shelter of the glorious House de Ardeur on the allod Lumenara.
r503019.n: House de Gloire? Is this a thing?

t: Oh, what joy, what beauty! Just look around you! It's like in the good old times!
r503020.n: Oh, what joy, what beauty! Just look around you! It's like in the good…

t: Glory to you, my good friend. I'm glad to see you on Irene.
r503021.n: Glory to you, my good friend. I'm glad to see you on Irene.

t: Oh, House de Conte! We're eternal travelers, wandering minstrels, roaming around Sarnaut and telling stories. We were like this centuries ago. We'll be like this in centuries to come. We do have a residence. We return to Stellar, under the cover of the eternal and endlessly wise night. We exchange the things we learned along the way, record our songs, and come up with new ballads.
r503022.n: I need to know about your House.

t: Harmony de Conte, traveling minstrel, at your service!
r503023.n: Harmony de Conte, traveling minstrel, at your service!

t: I would love for the Great Ball to start! I can't wait to dance!
r503028.n: I would love for the Great Ball to start! I can't wait to dance!

t: I'm Imelda de Luner. I'm... not afraid. Of anything. It's just... You know. It's Irene, right? It's swarming with spies... and plots... and conspiracies... Haven't you heard the story of the Great Ball? Everyone wants to win the Great Game. And the easiest way is to spy on your opponents! Find out about their plans! I overheard many... you know, many curious things. Did you know that the so-called artists stopped on Florenta allod on the way? I don't trust them. They're not who they say they are. I'm sure they're... cultists!
r503032.n: Who are you? What are you afraid of?

t: I'm Conrad de Craner, a noble representative of my ancient House. You must have heard about me. I performed numerous feats in my life. But my dream is to fight in a duel with a true master of sword! I hear there is such master on Irene. Bussy de Tristesse, a fencer who has never been defeated. I might throw a glove.
r503033.n: Greetings to you, too. What's your name?

t: House de Craner was a source for the royal army of the Velund dynasty! I have to admit, we're in decay now. Alas, the true masters of sword aren't valued among elves today. They prefer magic! Or rather, preferred - until recently. When the war with the Empire began, many elves decided that a good sword, especially enchanted, does a better job than an ice comet or a fireball! That's when our skills came in handy. My House has opened a fencing school in Lightwood. Among our students there are elves, Kanians, and even Gibberlings.
r503034.n: What is this House de Craner? What is it famous for?

t: You there! Hello! Would you like to cross swords with me? I don't insist, but just in case.
r503035.n: You there! Hello! Would you like to cross swords with me? I don't…

t: Phew! No way. Who hasn't heard about House de Luner? Oh well... Not many, I guess. That's because we're hiding from everyone on Nocturne. We're interested in collecting the most shocking secrets of Sarnaut! Did you know that Yasker and Rysina were lovers? Oh, come on, the word is on the street! How about this: Catherina is Aidenus's daughter! Amazing, right? And she was pregnant... from Sarn! Cool, huh? Wait, don't go! I can tell you about Zayan and Klavdia! Don't you want to know?
r503036.n: What about the House de Luner? Never heard of it.

t: My name is Geronimo de Mork. The filthy scum gravely offended me! The thing is... that my fiancée... Julia... Well, she's a little carefree. The bastard abused her naive vulnerability, fed her a pack of lies, and seduced her. I caught them naked in bed! Just as I grabbed my sword, the bastard jumped out of the window and ran away. I'll beat the crap out of him, I swear! Just let me find him. He'll know better than to seduce girls!
r503037.n: Who are you? Why are you looking for him?

t: Uh, haven't you heard? But oh well. We're madly famous. Although, sadly, we're not a Great House. We live on the allod Tempesta under the protection of House de Pluie, but nothing can falter our honor! You can track our House's history back to the times when Ollatars ruled the Irene allod. House de Mork was famous for its loyalty to the throne. Many daughters of our House became queens, and noble knights took positions of majordomos, councilors, and marshals. No one dares to offend the name of my House and get away with it.
r503040.n: Tell me about your House de Mork.

t: Psst! Hush! Walls have ears! Keep your voice down!
r503041.n: Psst! Hush! Walls have ears! Keep your voice down!

t: It isn't special. We've always been blocked out by more famous and glorious Houses. After the Cataclysm, we ended up on Yoggor. My House served House de Doucer for a long while, but after old Gramon died, and his heir Armando committed the notorious crime, we were forced to change sides. Nocturne is Yoggor's new name. After the eclipse, it belongs to House de Desirae. We're their loyal servants. Just the same as we were to our previous lords.
r503042.n: House de Roche? What's that about?

t: Wilhelmina de Roche. Nice to meet you. It's so good to be on Irene! Let me tell you more about myself. I'm the tutor of Prince Dakkar's children, Antoine and Julie de Desirae. Or Anton and Julia Valir if you use their mother's name. They stayed with their mother, so I had the chance to visit the Great Ball and make my dream come true. I miss my students, but I'm sure they'll be better off on Nocturne than in the busy palace of their grandfather. Although these kids surely know how to keep everyone busy.
r503043.n: Good day to you. Who are you?

t: My House is just a minor House you have probably never heard of. We live on the Gelida allod, by the grace of the reigning House de Blizare. Gelida is a harsh place, where winter lasts forever. But the forests are full of animals, and rivers and lakes are full of fish. The mission of my House is to provide food for everyone. Trade alone can't cover all our needs.
r503044.n: House de Ruse? Tell me more about it.

t: Do you know where I can find the elf Giacomo de Vevre?
r503047.n: Do you know where I can find the elf Giacomo de Vevre?

t: I'm Domingo de Ruse, friend! I'm a great hunter. I arrived here because a Royal Hunt was promised to me. Have you heard of it? How come? Let me tell you. There is a tradition: they organize a Royal Hunt after every Great Ball. There's a great location for hunt, the Egladien Forest, full of all kinds of game. Just imagine how we seek, chase, and kill the prey... and how it will be running away from the hunt in panic!

Our House is known for popularizing our philosophy and formula in life: "everything for pleasure." We're the most famous hedonists and people of leisure in Sarnaut. We strive to achieve as many pleasures in life as we can. We're always busy lounging in our hidden shelter on Ellanash allod. We taste delicate food, listen to elegant music, study the most elaborate erotic practices...
r503049.n: What is this House de Fore? What are you doing?

t: Jessica de Fore, at your service. I arrived at Irene to satisfy my passion to exquisite pleasures. It is widely known that there's no other place like the Rose and Hibiscus! Alas, I heard, it's not to easy to get inside. I'm looking for an opportunity to visit.
Hey-ho! Welcome to the blessed allod!
r503051.n: Hey-ho! Welcome to the blessed allod!

t: Well, all historians are his students, in a sense. Just like my good friend Roxane, the head of our House, I belong to those who avoided the fate of turning into a vampire and escaped in a shelter on Nea. Zayan is wise, but he's mistaken. None of it really happened.
r503054.n: Wait a minute, aren't you Zayan's student?

t: Good afternoon! I'm glad to see so many new faces on Irene.
r503055.n: Good afternoon! I'm glad to see so many new faces on Irene.

t: Ah! Mirages. Nothing but mirages, created by Cosmos, Sarn's evil minion. He used the Observatory and with the help of the traitor Klavdia created an illusion of the future, where Nihaz allegedly "destroyed" the world. If you think about it, this is just stupid. No idea why Nihaz might need this. Wasn't he trying to explain to you how this world works? Didn't he help you fight the insane cultists of Sarn? You shouldn't believe Cosmos or anything he shows you in his so-called "Observatory".
r503056.n: How about the death of the world and other events?

t: I carefully analyzed his work and found a number of inconsistencies. Here's my version: in fact, Sarn is an evil tyrant, obsessed with spreading the Light, wanting to control everything. Only the Dark God Nihaz can do good to Sarnaut. All he ever wanted is for us to progress and develop. Nihaz can give us knowledge that will make us gods!
Good afternoon! Where can I... where can I find the Rose and Hibiscus? Although... you don't know, of course. Why would you?
r503064.n: Good afternoon! Where can I... where can I find the Rose and Hibiscus?…

t: The thing is, all the events, which Zayan describes in his latest work about the recent past, are all made up. None of it happened in reality. In fact, Nihaz never locked up Sarn. On the contrary, Sarn locked up Nihaz. He chained him to a rock for giving people the gift of magic.
Oh, hey, I know you. You're Zayan's acolyte. He constructs his dubious historical theories based on your deeds and visions.
r503066.n: Oh, hey, I know you. You're Zayan's acolyte. He constructs his dubious…

t: Yes, Hedus-Avior-Mirach is what they called me when I was whole! The river of time carried those days away. Nihaz imprisoned me here a long time ago. He used me as a power source for this Citadel and all sorts of operations. I resisted for as long as I could, but in the end, I lost myself in this prison. Curse Nihaz to eternal damnation! Thank you for freeing me. Now I can become one with eternity... Farewell.
r503105.n: Yes, Hedus-Avior-Mirach is what they called me when I was whole! The…

t: Talk to other patrons, rest, dance, try cocktails and hookahs, swim in the pool. There are also individual pavilions if you'd like to get away from the noise.
r503179.n: What is there to do around here?

t: Welcome to the Rose and Hibiscus! Do you have any questions?
r503184.n: Welcome to the Rose and Hibiscus! Do you have any questions?

t:
Gambling, mostly.

Why? Otherwise life gets boring. Only underground rats lived here till the elves came back. We enjoyed ourselves the best we could.

I don't have enough shiny baubles. Bring more shiny baubles, and the game will be more fun! I have to beg big guys like you for them!
We sell pleasure. My goods are for those who consider love the most important of all arts.
r503367.n: We sell pleasure. My goods are for those who consider love the most…

t: Only our trusted patrons who have the key.
No, guests are not allowed here. The mistress's personal chambers.
Of course! Just use your key!
Irene is broken into many shards, but this is no obstacle for traveling. At your service! Where would you like to go?
r503560.n: Irene is broken into many shards, but this is no obstacle for…

t: First time? Alright, I'll give you a hint – just change all letters to the next one in the alphabet.
r503656.n: How do I decipher the code?

t: Great. Here's the package, it's all there. I wrote the info on the liaison's whereabouts and appearance on the package. It will be gibberish for anyone else, but you'll figure it out...
r503657.n: I'm here for the information. [Give the password]

t: A part of your mission, right? I have the package Take it... And good luck.
r503658.n: I need information for the liaison.

t: Ugh, I almost... Alright, colleague. What do you want from me?
r503659.n: I'm on your side. I'm a double agent, too.

t: , is that you? Oh Tep, another minute and there'll be clash of blades... I'm also an undercover agent. What do you want?
r503663.n: I'm here for the information. [Give the password]

r503664.n: Hmm, that was awkward... [Finish the conversation]

t: What?! You... Here, take it, I don't want any problems! I won't tell anyone! It's all written on the package – the place and the person who should get it!
r503665.n: I'm on your side. I'm a double agent, too.

t: Great. Instructions for all agents for the next few days: hunt down the blue raven. Go now.
r503688.n: [Hand over the package] It's all here. What are my next instructions?

t: Keep that up. Instructions for the next day: take care of the little swallow. You can go now.
r503689.n: [Hand over the package] It's all here. What are my next instructions?

t: Good job, soon you won't have to run errands anymore... Your next instructions: do not give the bear white honey. See you soon.
r503690.n: [Hand over the package] It's all here. What are my next instructions?

t: Very well. This is the instruction: drink water from the lake where hedgehogs swim.
r503691.n: [Hand over the package] It's all here. What are my next instructions?

t: Yep. New instructions for all agents: dance under the moon near the blue canals.
r503692.n: [Hand over the package] It's all here. What are my next instructions?

t: How about that. Your next instructions: watch the lovely sunrise after buying wine.
r503693.n: [Hand over the package] It's all here. What are my next instructions?

t: Good job! Instructions for the next day: tame the deer that want to eat grass!
r503694.n: [Hand over the package] It's all here. What are my next instructions?

t: Everyone is here... New instructions for all agents: sit on the stump until the blackbird returns to the nest!
r503695.n: [Hand over the package] It's all here. What are my next instructions?

t: That’s good. Your new instructions: march where everyone can see you so the cats run away!
r503696.n: [Hand over the package] It's all here. What are my next instructions?

t: Great! Instructions for the next day: do not touch the hedgehog's prickles until it falls asleep.
r503697.n: [Hand over the package] It's all here. What are my next instructions?

t: Got it. Directive for the next day: do not jump into the canals unless you have scared the fish away.
r503698.n: [Hand over the package] It's all here. What are my next instructions?

t: Well, well. Good. Instructions for the next day: do not be silent near entrances on the main streets.
r503699.n: [Hand over the package] It's all here. What are my next instructions?

r503700.n: [Hand over the package] It's all here. What are my next instructions?

t: Great, you took your time. Good work. You have the information?
Is this some kind of joke?

t:
It’s simple: the residence of de Delice, residence of de Blizare, then through the port and the main street, through the park and the square of the Northern districts to the local pier... The task becomes more interesting then: you need to find a checkpoint in all three parts of the forest in turn: northern, eastern, and southern.

Everyone picks their own route. The only condition is you need to go through all checkpoints in the correct order and reach the finish line!
Just choose your transport, and if there are free spots in the upcoming race, you’ll be teleported to the start!

t:
At first we wanted to reward the racers for the top places, but it turned out such competition provokes... Varying responses, so to speak.

So instead you can beat the records for this route and get medals as a reward, along with an honorary title!

The first one who wishes to start a race picks their transport and begins preparations. The preparation lasts 1 minute, and that is when other participants can join. One race can have up to 10 participants.

The race starts once the minute is over. Your goal is to cross the checkpoints in order as fast as you can. The next checkpoint becomes visible once you cross the previous one, so you won’t be able to fool our magic!

To be faster than anyone else, use the abilities of your transport and plan your route carefully!

Together, We will present our terms to the League. There will be no war with the Empire. Don't even think about taking advantage of its vulnerability!
